name: GoliathAlign
tagline: Standalone multi-platform bisulfite alignment, in the style of Clara Parabricks fq2bam_meth and bwa-meth.
description: GoliathAlign maps whole-genome bisulfite reads on Linux x86-64 and ARM64, on CPU, NVIDIA CUDA, or AMD HIP. The linear aligner, `MojoFq2bamMeth`, follows the directional C→T / G→A method used by bwa-meth and by NVIDIA Clara Parabricks `fq2bam_meth`, and writes a coordinate-sorted BAM plus QC JSON. The same install aligns reads to converted genome graphs and calls methylation from the resulting GAF. Install a checkout with pixi, or unpack the Ubuntu 22.04 host runtime published as release `0.1.0-jammy`.

features.title: Linear bisulfite alignment
features.description: MojoFq2bamMeth converts read 1 C→T and read 2 G→A, maps them with an FM-index on a bwa-meth dual-strand reference (k-mer and BWA-MEM engines are selectable), and writes a duplicate-marked BAM, a BAI, and a Parabricks-shaped QC JSON.

features.title: CPU, NVIDIA, and AMD
features.description: Device selection accepts auto, cpu, nvidia (nvidia:sm_90, CUDA), and amd (amdgpu:gfx942 or METHYLGRAPHER_AMDGPU_ARCH, HIP) through Mojo DeviceContext. Pixi solves linux-64 and linux-aarch64.

features.title: Graph alignment and methylation calls
features.description: Align and MojoGiraffe write GAF for C→T and G→A graphs (vg giraffe, or the Mojo Giraffe mapper). MethylCall, MergeCpG, and ConversionRate consume that GAF.

features.title: Pixi checkout and jammy runtime
features.description: pixi install provides the Mojo toolchain. Release 0.1.0-jammy is goliath-align-host-linux-amd64-jammy.tar.gz, an Ubuntu 22.04 amd64 tree with bin/methylGrapher and a bundled mojo.
